messages:
pilar: heads-up - onboarding sample-app failing on python flow. REST returns metadata when we pass return_raw_metadata but python sdk (v0.9.7) ignores it. sample-app then crashes when it can't attach source ids.

ash: can you drop a repro? quick snippets pls.

pilar: curl repro:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/batch \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"inputs":["doc"], "return_raw_metadata": true}'
```
returns 200 and metadata[].

pilar: python sdk code (sample-app):
```py
await client.embeddings.create(
  model='open-embed-1',
  inputs=['doc'],
  include_raw=True
)
```
no metadata returned. sample-app log: KeyError when reading metadata.

sara: naming mismatch for sure. REST uses return_raw_metadata snake_case. our py-sdk exposes include_raw (older name) and we map to return_raw_metadata in transport for known keys, but include_raw wasn't wired in the new param mapper.

ash: hmm also saw a weird dup enqueue in logs when auth rotated: initial request got 202 Accepted + Location, then token refresh happened and SDK retried the POST which caused a second enqueue. authentication flow shouldn't replay non-idempotent POSTs after token refresh.

tony: that's big. duplicate indexing jobs + missing metadata = bad. we need two fixes: 1) wire include_raw -> return_raw_metadata mapping in py-sdk mapper, 2) change auth retry behavior so POSTs that already returned 202 (accepted) are treated as terminal and not retried on refresh, and also avoid automatic replay of POST bodies after refresh unless explicitly idempotent.

pilar: repro notes: attach sequence: POST -> 202 + Location job=q_55, SDK got 401 when token rotated, SDK auto-refreshed and retried -> job=q_56. We have logs in staging.

sara: proposed dev plan: small py-sdk PR to add alias and unit tests; separate auth middleware PR to make replay behavior opt-in for non-idempotent methods. add an integration test that mocks 202 + Location and ensures no retry.

ash: add a sample-app template change too: change default request timeout to 30s (was 8s) to reduce client-side timeouts that trigger retries during slow metadata fetch. also add a short README blurb that experimental flags are snake_case on the wire.

dev-bot: created issue py-sdk#712: "include_raw mapping + 202 handling for embeddings.batch"

ci-bot: last relevant CI: sample-app-integration failed at 2150012000 (flaky embed test)

tony: assign P0 for the auth middleware fix, P1 for the param mapping. I'll own the auth PR. pilar/sara can handle the py-sdk change.

pilar: thanks. I'll leave the staging logs and the curl/python repro in the issue. keeping thread open until PRs merge and staging green. :+1:
